gaps_closed.posture: Studio consumes display profiles and does not measure them. Per-monitor OS profile read and reacted to on change, user-supplied ICC display profiles, correct behaviour when monitors differ, an explicit unmanaged state, and the active profile exposed in Argus. Hardware calibration is an optional out-of-process adapter lane, not a required capability.
Delivered through the OCIO v2 requirement already in the module. The document records which config and version it was authored against so a grade is reproducible.
CIEDE2000 with per-path tolerances and a golden patch corpus. Before this the spec required correct colour but stated no number, so no validator could gate it.

Waveform, parade, vectorscope and histogram specified as a colour-analysis contract measured relative to the timeline working space, with legal-range checking. 14.25 points at it via the non-yielding cross-reference STU-VID-105.
Limit declaration sites and precedence, evaluation on composed separated device values, a typed violation finding, and published limits recorded as reference rather than as a Studio default.

Materialisation is scalar, SIMD-disabled and bit-identical; application may use SIMD and the GPU under a stated tolerance. The interpolation rule is now part of the transform cache key, so a CPU proof render and a GPU viewport can no longer disagree while claiming the same transform.

open_gate.item: ICC Output-class (prtr) B2A evaluation in the candidate colour-management module
open_gate.why: The recommended pure-Rust engine documents Display-class coverage; Output class is what CMYK separation and soft-proofing need. The API exposes ProfileClass and a full LUT family so the machinery appears present, but this was not established from documentation.
open_gate.status: HARD PREDECESSOR - must be tested against a real Output-class profile before the colour work is authored. Failure changes the engine recommendation.
